types.name: BasicCamera2dService
types.summary: Provides basic 2D camera functionality for managing the position and translation of a canvas in a 2D world.
types.remarks:
This service allows setting and retrieving the camera's position in the 2D world
space through the BasicCamera2dService.Position property. It requires an Interfaces.ICanvas instance to be set
using the BasicCamera2dService.SetCanvas method before use.

members.name: Zoom
members.summary: Gets or sets the zoom of the canvas, where 1 is unscaled and 2 draws the world twice as large.

parameters.description: The canvas instance to set. Cannot be null.

members.name: Initialize
members.summary: Performs initialization logic for the derived class.

types.name: Entity2dOption<E>
types.summary: Represents an abstract base class for creating options specific to 2D entities.

types.name: Anchor2d
types.summary: Represents a 2D anchor point that defines a position and orientation relative to a parent entity.
types.remarks:
The Entities.Anchor2d class provides a way to specify a position and orientation
in 2D space, either in absolute coordinates or as a fraction of the parent entity's size. The anchor's
position and orientation are used to calculate its screen bounds relative to the parent entity.

members.name: Parent
members.summary: Gets the parent entity of the current 2D entity.

members.name: Position
members.summary: Gets or sets the position of the object in 2D space.

members.name: Orientation
members.summary: Gets or sets the 2D orientation of the object.

members.name: OrientationType
members.summary: Gets or sets the orientation type of the object.

members.name: ScreenBounds
members.summary: Gets or sets the screen-space bounds of the current object.
members.remarks:
The bounds are determined relative to the parent object's screen bounds and
the object's orientation. Setting this property adjusts the object's position relative to its
parent.

types.name: Entity2d
types.signature: public abstract class Entity2d : Entity, IAnchor2d
types.summary: Represents a 2D entity with position, scale, rotation, size, and origin properties.

members.name: Entity2d
members.summary:
Initializes a new instance of the Entity2d class with default position, scale, rotation, size, and
origin values.
members.remarks:
This protected constructor is intended for use by derived classes to ensure
that all spatial properties are initialized to their default states.

members.name: Position
members.summary: Gets or sets the position represented by a two-dimensional vector.

members.name: Scale
members.summary: Gets or sets the scaling factor applied to the object along the X and Y axes.

members.name: Rotation
members.summary: Gets or sets the rotation angle, in degrees, applied to the object.

members.name: Size
members.summary: Gets or sets the two-dimensional size of the object.

members.name: Origin
members.summary: Gets or sets the origin point of the object in 2D space.

members.name: ScreenBounds
members.summary: Gets or sets the bounding rectangle of the entity in screen coordinates.
members.remarks:
Setting this property updates the entity's position and size relative to its
parent. The screen bounds are calculated based on the entity's position and size, as well as the screen
bounds of its parent if applicable.

members.name: CreateAnchor
members.signature: public Anchor2d CreateAnchor(Vec2 anchorPosition, Orientation2d orientation = 0, OrientationType orientationType = 0)
members.summary: Creates a new 2D anchor at the specified position with the given orientation and orientation type.
members.returns: A new Anchor2d instance configured with the specified position, orientation, and orientation type.

parameters.name: anchorPosition
parameters.description: The position of the anchor in 2D space.

parameters.name: orientation
parameters.description: The orientation of the anchor relative to its position. Defaults to Orientation2d.UpperLeft.

parameters.name: orientationType
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the orientation is interpreted as absolute or relative. Defaults to
OrientationType.Absolute.

types.name: Orientation2d
types.summary: Specifies the corner an entity is oriented from.

members.name: UpperLeft
members.summary: The upper left corner.

members.name: UpperRight
members.summary: The upper right corner.

members.name: LowerLeft
members.summary: The lower left corner.

members.name: LowerRight
members.summary: The lower right corner.

types.name: OrientationType
types.summary: Specifies how an orientation value is interpreted.

members.name: Absolute
members.summary: The value is an absolute offset.

members.name: Fraction
members.summary: The value is a fraction of the size.

types.name: SizeMode
types.summary: Specifies how a drawable texture is rendered within its size bounds.

members.name: Clip
members.summary: The texture is drawn at its natural size, clipped at the size boundaries.

members.name: Stretch
members.summary: The texture is stretched to fit the entire size.

types.name: Drawable2d
types.summary: Represents a two-dimensional drawable object with position, size, scale, rotation, and origin properties.
types.remarks:
This is a base class for drawable objects in a 2D space. Derived classes can override the Size property
to define custom dimensions. The class provides a concrete BoundingBox implementation that accounts for position,
origin, scale, and rotation.

members.name: Drawable2d
members.summary: Initializes a new instance of the Drawables.Drawable2d class.
members.remarks:
This constructor sets the initial position of the drawable object to Vec2.Zero,
origin to Vec2.Zero (top-left), scale to Vec2.One, and rotation to 0 degrees.

members.name: Position
members.summary: Gets or sets the position of the object in 2D space.

members.name: Origin
members.summary: Gets or sets the origin point that the Position refers to. (0,0) is top-left, (0.5,0.5) is center.

members.name: Size
members.summary: Gets or sets the size of the object as a two-dimensional vector.

members.name: Scale
members.summary: Gets or sets the scale of the object as a two-dimensional vector.

members.name: Rotation
members.summary: Gets or sets the rotation angle, in degrees.

members.name: BoundingBox
members.summary: Gets the rectangular bounding box of the drawable, accounting for position, origin, scale, and rotation.

types.name: Drawable2dOption<D>
types.summary: Represents an option for configuring a 2D drawable object.
types.remarks:
This class provides configuration options specific to 2D drawable objects, such as
their position, origin, scale, and rotation.

members.name: Position
members.summary: Gets or sets the position of the object in 2D space.

members.name: Origin
members.summary: Gets or sets the origin point that the Position refers to.

members.name: Scale
members.summary: Gets or sets the scale of the object.

members.name: Rotation
members.summary: Gets or sets the rotation angle in degrees.

members.name: Create
members.summary:
Assigns the specified position, origin, scale, and rotation to the object and returns a value indicating whether the operation was
successful.
members.returns: true if the operation was successful; otherwise, false.

parameters.name: obj
parameters.description: The object to which the properties will be assigned.

types.name: DrawableFont
types.summary: Represents a drawable text element that can be rendered on a 2D canvas using a specified font.
types.remarks:
This class allows rendering multi-line text with customizable properties such as
font, scale, rotation, color, and flipping. The text is automatically split into lines based on newline
characters, and the size of the drawable is updated accordingly.

members.name: DrawableFont
members.summary: Initializes a new instance of the Drawables.DrawableFont class with default settings.
members.remarks:
The default settings include a scale of Vec2.One, a rotation of 0,
a color of Color.White, no flipping (Flipped.None), and an empty list of
lines.

members.name: Font
members.summary: Gets or sets the font used for rendering text.
members.remarks:
Changing the font triggers an update to recalculate the size and layout of
the text.

members.name: Text
members.summary: Gets or sets the text content.

members.name: Lines
members.signature: public List<string> Lines { get; protected set; }
members.summary: Gets the collection of lines associated with this instance.

members.name: Color
members.summary: Gets or sets the color associated with the object.

members.name: Flipped
members.summary: Gets or sets the flipped state of the object.

members.name: Initialize
members.summary: Performs initialization logic for the component.
members.remarks:
This method is called during the component's lifecycle to set up any
necessary state or resources. Override this method to provide custom initialization logic.

members.name: Cleanup
members.summary: Releases resources used by the object and performs any necessary cleanup operations.
members.remarks:
This method is called to ensure that any unmanaged resources or other
disposable objects associated with the instance are properly released. Override this method to
implement custom cleanup logic specific to the derived class.

members.name: Draw
members.summary: Draws the text onto the specified canvas using the configured font, position, and other rendering options.
members.remarks:
This method renders the text line by line, starting at the specified position
and applying the configured font, scale, rotation, color, and other properties. If the font or text is
not set, the method does nothing.

parameters.name: canvas
parameters.description: The canvas on which the text will be drawn. Cannot be null.

types.name: DrawableFontOption

members.name: Font
members.summary: Gets or sets the font to use.

members.name: Text

members.name: Color
members.summary: Gets or sets the text color.

members.name: Flipped
members.summary: Gets or sets how the text is flipped.

members.name: Create
members.summary: Applies the options that were set to the given drawable.
members.returns: true if the drawable was configured; otherwise false.

parameters.name: obj

types.name: DrawableTexture
types.summary:
Represents a drawable 2D texture that can be rendered on a canvas with configurable properties such as
scale, rotation, color, and flipping.
types.remarks:
This class extends Drawables.Drawable2d and provides additional functionality for
rendering textures. The texture can be customized using properties such as scale, rotation, color, and flipping.
The DrawableTexture.Draw method is used to render the texture on the specified canvas.

members.name: DrawableTexture
members.summary: Represents a drawable texture with properties for scaling, rotation, color, and flipping.
members.remarks:
This constructor initializes the drawable texture with default values from the base Drawable2d class,
plus color set to white and flipping set to None.

members.name: Texture
members.summary: Gets or sets the texture associated with the object.

members.name: Color
members.summary: Gets or sets the color associated with the object.

members.name: Flipped
members.summary: Gets or sets the flipped state of the object.

members.name: Size
members.summary: Gets or sets the size of the texture display area. If set to zero, the texture's natural size is used.

members.name: SizeMode
members.summary: Gets or sets how the texture is rendered within the Size bounds.

members.name: Initialize
members.summary: Performs initialization tasks required for the component.
members.remarks:
This method is called to set up the component before it is used. Override
this method to include any custom initialization logic specific to the derived class. Ensure that any
required resources are properly initialized within this method.

members.name: Cleanup
members.summary: Releases resources or performs cleanup operations specific to the derived class.
members.remarks:
This method is called to allow the derived class to release unmanaged
resources, reset state, or perform other cleanup tasks. Override this method to implement custom
cleanup logic.

members.name: Draw
members.summary:
Draws the current entity on the specified canvas using the configured texture, position, scale,
rotation, color, and other properties.
members.remarks:
This method renders the entity's texture on the provided canvas, applying
transformations such as scaling, rotation, flipping, and origin offset. If the DrawableTexture.Texture property is
null, the method does not perform any drawing.

parameters.name: canvas
parameters.description: The canvas on which the entity will be drawn. Cannot be null.

types.name: DrawableTextureOption
types.summary: Represents an option for configuring a Drawables.DrawableTexture object, including its associated texture.
types.remarks:
This class provides a way to specify a DrawableTextureOption.Texture that can be applied to
a Drawables.DrawableTexture during its creation. It extends the functionality of
Drawables.Drawable2dOption`1 to include texture-specific configuration.

members.name: Texture
members.summary: Gets or sets the texture associated with the object.

members.name: Size
members.summary: Gets or sets the size of the texture display area.

members.name: SizeMode
members.summary: Gets or sets how the texture is rendered within the Size bounds.

members.name: Flipped
members.summary: Gets or sets how the texture is flipped.

members.name: Create
members.summary: Creates and initializes a Drawables.DrawableTexture object.
members.remarks:
If the DrawableTextureOption.Texture property is not null, it will
be assigned to the obj instance. Size, SizeMode, and Flipped options are also applied if provided.
members.returns:
true if the object was successfully created and initialized; otherwise,
false.

parameters.name: obj
parameters.description: The Drawables.DrawableTexture instance to be initialized.

members.name: Drawable2dComponent
members.summary: Creates and returns a preconfigured Data.Component instance for 2D drawable objects.
members.remarks:
The returned Data.Component is specifically tailored for 2D drawable
entities, with its class name, namespace, and template set to match the Drawables.Drawable2d type. It
also establishes a parent-child relationship with the core drawable component.
members.returns: A Data.Component instance configured for 2D drawable objects.

members.name: DrawableTextureComponent
members.summary: Creates and returns a preconfigured Data.Component instance for 2D drawable objects.
members.remarks:
The returned Data.Component is specifically tailored for 2D drawable
entities, with its class name, namespace, and template set to match the Drawables.Drawable2d type. It
also establishes a parent-child relationship with the core drawable component.
members.returns: A Data.Component instance configured for 2D drawable objects.

members.name: Entity2dComponent
members.summary: Creates and returns a new 2D entity component.
members.remarks:
The returned component is configured with the class name and namespace of the
Entities.Entity2d type, a template of type Components.Entity2dComponentTemplate, and a parent component
derived from CoreComponent.EntityComponent. The base type is set to Entities.Entity.
members.returns: A Data.Component instance representing a 2D entity component.

types.remarks:
This class provides initialization logic and filtering capabilities for components that are
associated with 2D drawable objects. It is intended to be used as a base for defining specific 2D drawable
component templates.

members.remarks:

the filter criteria.

types.name: DrawableTextureComponentTemplate
types.summary: Represents a template for creating 2D drawable components.

associated with 2D drawable objects. It is intended to be used as a base for defining specific 2D drawable
component templates.

types.remarks:

include drawable components. It extends the Components.ComponentTemplate`1 base class with a specific
implementation for Entity.Entity2dCode.

before calling this method.

types.name: SelectionController2DDrawable
types.summary:
Handles all pointer interaction of the 2D editor overlays: picking the topmost node under the cursor,
click and Ctrl+Click selection, drag selection box, and moving or resizing the selected nodes together,
keeping their relative positions and sizes. It also draws the gizmos of the active tool and the combined
bounds when multiple nodes are selected.

members.name: PickTopMost
members.signature: public static Debug2DDrawable PickTopMost(IEnumerable<Debug2DDrawable> drawables, Vec2 point)
members.summary:
Picks the node to select at a point: the hit node with the highest draw order wins; nodes without a
draw order (entities) fall back to the hierarchy, where the innermost node wins.
members.returns: The topmost overlay at the point, or null if there is none.

parameters.name: drawables
parameters.description: The editor overlays in hierarchy order (parents before children).

parameters.name: point
parameters.description: The world point to test.
